description: Implementation of a file manager using Infinispan cache for managing static content files such as images, JS, CSS, PDF, and multimedia files in a CMS. Supports adding, retrieving, and removing files and directories for merchant stores.

classes.name: CmsStaticContentFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Manages static content files via Infinispan cache for a multi-tenant CMS system. Implements methods to add, retrieve, list, and delete static files tied to merchant store codes and content types.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager and logs the operation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the file manager.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a static content file for a merchant store to the cache.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a merchant store to the cache.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a static content file by filename for a given merchant and content type.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all static content files for a merchant store and content type.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file from the store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create a cache node for a given path.

methods.name: getNodePath
methods.description: Constructs the cache node path for a store code and content type.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Lists all file names stored for a specific store and content type.
